source: Single-parameter sensitivity: Amzn v_max=44 m/s in the public 2024 fork rotor table; all other values retain configs/uav_types.json and 2026 Table 3.
reconstruction_choices: Only Amzn maximum TAS changes, from 196 kt to 44 m/s (44*3600/1852 kt). Its existing 0.8 nominal fraction consequently gives 35.2 m/s.
The knot-valued field preserves the existing performance loader interface. The sensitivity runner checks the resulting SI values and equality of the other eleven type records.
Amzn climb/descent remain 8 m/s. All types retain the existing 3.5 m/s2 acceleration, zero minimum TAS and current native bank/vertical dynamics.
This deliberately mixed table isolates one public-source parameter discrepancy. It is neither the full 2024 OpenAP model nor an identified 2026 author implementation.
